description: This source file contains fuzz testing code for the BackoffEntrySerializer component in the net namespace, including functions for testing serialization/deserialization properties and a fuzzing entry point.

classes.name: ProtoTranslator
classes.description: A helper class to convert fuzz input protobuf fields into BackoffEntry parameters and time objects.

classes.name: MockClock
classes.description: A mock implementation of base::TickClock for controlling time during tests.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::policy
methods.description: Returns a BackoffEntry::Policy object derived from the protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::parse_time
methods.description: Returns a base::Time object parsed from the protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::parse_time_ticks
methods.description: Returns a base::TimeTicks object parsed from the protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::serialize_time
methods.description: Returns a base::Time object for serialization time from the protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::now_ticks
methods.description: Returns a base::TimeTicks object representing current time from the protobuf input.

methods.name: ProtoTranslator::serialized_entry
methods.description: Converts serialized entry protobuf to a base::Value object.

methods.name: TestDeserialize
methods.description: Tests the deserialize-reserialize property of BackoffEntry serialization.

methods.name: TestSerialize
methods.description: Tests the serialize-deserialize property of BackoffEntry serialization.
